sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: Celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 庆祝175年来，我们始终致力于帮助您了解世界，充实每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: Hey everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: So I have a haul.
sentences.zh: 我刚买了一大堆东西。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Katrin Benholt.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的凯特琳·本霍尔特。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》节目。

sentences.en: Y'all, this box is so heavy.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这个盒子太沉了。

sentences.en: Yeah, $1 shirts, $2 shirts, $3 shirts, $5 dresses.
sentences.zh: 没错，1美元的衬衫，2美元的衬衫，3美元的衬衫，5美元的裙子。

sentences.en: Like, it was ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 简直太离谱了。

sentences.en: For years, American consumers have been able to spend next to nothing on the latest fashion trends.
sentences.zh: 多年来，美国消费者一直能以几乎零成本买到最新的时尚潮流。

sentences.en: So for a sweatshirt, a t-shirt, and a tank top, the total was $14.82 off of Shein.
sentences.zh: 所以，在Shein上买一件卫衣、一件T恤和一件背心，总共才花了14.82美元。

sentences.en: If you want to be a baddie on a budget, Shein is the way to go.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在预算有限的情况下走辣妹风，Shein绝对是首选。

sentences.en: Thanks, in large part, to Chinese clothing companies like Shein.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上要归功于像Shein这样的中国服装公司。

sentences.en: I might be the overconsumption final boss because I keep buying the same things, just different colors and in different fonts.
sentences.zh: 我可能是过度消费界的终极BOSS，因为我一直在买同样的东西，只是颜色和款式略有不同。

sentences.en: That have long used a loophole to send millions of packages a day into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它们长期利用一个漏洞，每天向美国发送数百万个包裹。

sentences.en: from China, tax-free.
sentences.zh: 而且是从中国免税发货。

sentences.en: But now...
sentences.zh: 但现在……

sentences.en: She and these new prices got me looking like, what?
sentences.zh: Shein这些新价格让我觉得，这是什么情况？

sentences.en: President Trump is killing that loophole, even as he de-escalates his larger trade war with China.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统正在封堵这个漏洞，尽管他同时也在缓和与中国之间更大规模的贸易战。

sentences.en: A dress I had on my car was like $9.
sentences.zh: 我购物车里的一条裙子之前大概9美元。

sentences.en: It's $18 now.
sentences.zh: 现在要18美元了。

sentences.en: They were in flames.
sentences.zh: 它们当时火得一塌糊涂。

sentences.en: And prices are going up.
sentences.zh: 而且价格正在上涨。

sentences.en: What if, like, prices just, like, never go down?
sentences.zh: 如果价格就这么一直涨下去，再也不降了怎么办？

sentences.en: Like, what if I could never get a miniskirt for $7 ever again?
sentences.zh: 如果我再也买不到7美元的迷你裙了怎么办？

sentences.en: Like, I'm scared.
sentences.zh: 我好害怕。

sentences.en: Today, I talk with my colleague Megan Tobin about whether this might be the end of fast fashion.
sentences.zh: 今天，我和同事梅根·托宾聊聊这是否意味着快时尚的终结。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月15日，星期四。

sentences.en: Are you guys going to miss the prices before the tariffs?
sentences.zh: 你们会怀念关税实施前的价格吗？

sentences.en: Let me know in the comments.
sentences.zh: 在评论区告诉我吧。

sentences.en: Megan, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 梅根，欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: So, I know you've been reporting on Shein and other fast fashion companies for many years.
sentences.zh: 我知道你报道Shein和其他快时尚公司已经很多年了。

sentences.en: But I can reveal to you that I am also an expert on the subject because I have a teenage daughter who spends a lot of her time and pocket money on Shein.
sentences.zh: 但我可以向你透露，我也是这方面的专家，因为我有个十几岁的女儿，她把很多时间和零花钱都花在了Shein上。

sentences.en: And I did my research before coming on today and asked her about her latest haul.
sentences.zh: 今天来之前我特意做了功课，问了她最近买的战利品。

sentences.en: Tell me what she bought.
sentences.zh: 告诉我她买了什么。

sentences.en: So, she got a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 她买了很多东西。

sentences.en: Wait for it.
sentences.zh: 你猜怎么着。

sentences.en: She got a bikini for $5, a jewelry box for $2.60, a phone case for $2, a tube top for $2, a couple of tank tops for $4 each, a claw clip for just under $1.
sentences.zh: 她买了一件5美元的比基尼，一个2.6美元的首饰盒，一个2美元的手机壳，一件2美元的抹胸，两件各4美元的背心，还有一个不到1美元的发抓。

sentences.en: And I think the single most expensive thing on her receipt was actually a pair of jean shorts for, like, $6.
sentences.zh: 我想她那张购物单上最贵的一件东西，其实是一条牛仔短裤，大概6美元。

sentences.en: It's kind of insane.
sentences.zh: 这简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: That sounds like a classic Shein haul.
sentences.zh: 听起来这就是典型的Shein式购物。

sentences.en: And I'm really wondering, how can they keep it this cheap?
sentences.zh: 我真的很纳闷，他们怎么能把价格压得这么低？

sentences.en: So, clothing from Shein is so cheap in part because until a couple weeks ago, it could come into the United States without anyone having to pay any taxes on it,
sentences.zh: Shein的衣服之所以这么便宜，部分原因在于直到几周前，这些商品进入美国时无需缴纳任何关税。

sentences.en: thanks to a tax loophole called the De Minimis Exemption.
sentences.zh: 这要归功于一个名为“最低限度条款”的税收漏洞。

sentences.en: But that loophole has now been closed, which means customers in the United States are going to have to pay more to get their fast fashion.
sentences.zh: 但现在这个漏洞已经被堵上了，这意味着美国的消费者以后买快时尚产品得花更多的钱了。

sentences.en: And it's still closed, even though China and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且它依然处于关闭状态，尽管中国和美国……

sentences.en: passed their super-high tariffs earlier this week?
sentences.zh: 在本周早些时候通过了超高关税？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: On Monday,
sentences.zh: 周一的时候，

sentences.en: President Trump issued an executive order saying that goods that previously would have come into the United States under this loophole will now be subject to tariffs of 54%.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统发布了一项行政命令，规定此前通过该漏洞进入美国的商品，现在将面临54%的关税。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, let's talk about this loophole.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们来聊聊这个漏洞。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 它到底是什么？

sentences.en: So, this loophole is called the De Minimis Exemption, and it's basically Latin for it's too small to matter.
sentences.zh: 这个漏洞被称为“最低限度条款”，在拉丁语中基本就是“太小而不值一提”的意思。

sentences.en: And it started back in the 1930s when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它始于20世纪30年代，当时美国……

sentences.en: government was trying to come up with a threshold for which it basically decided it was not worth the effort to collect taxes on imports under a certain value.
sentences.zh: 政府试图设定一个门槛，认为低于该价值的进口商品不值得费力去征税。

sentences.en: So, in the 1930s, the De Minimis Exemption was $1,
sentences.zh: 所以，在20世纪30年代，最低限度条款的门槛是1美元。

sentences.en: and the De Minimis Threshold was raised in the 90s as part of a wave of new trade policies worldwide that were based on the idea that more open trade would benefit everybody.
sentences.zh: 而在90年代，作为全球贸易政策新浪潮的一部分，基于“更开放的贸易将惠及所有人”的理念，这个门槛被提高了。

sentences.en: And it was raised again to $800 in 2016.
sentences.zh: 2016年，它又被提高到了800美元。

sentences.en: I mean, that feels like a pretty high amount to not pay any tariffs on.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这个免税额度也太高了。

sentences.en: What was the justification for letting this threshold be this high in the United States?
sentences.zh: 美国当初把这个门槛定得这么高的理由是什么？

sentences.en: The thinking at the time was that this would help American businesses who relied on imported goods.
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，这能帮助那些依赖进口商品的美国企业。

sentences.en: And it really coincided with a period of time when online shopping took off around the world,
sentences.zh: 这恰好与全球网购兴起的时期重合，

sentences.en: and also when the Chinese government was pushing businesses in China to find markets overseas.
sentences.zh: 也正值中国政府推动国内企业开拓海外市场之时。

sentences.en: The Chinese government wanted China to be the world's factory.
sentences.zh: 中国政府希望中国成为“世界工厂”。

sentences.en: And so, all of that really opened the floodgates into the United States for low-cost goods from China.
sentences.zh: 因此，这一切确实为中国低成本商品进入美国打开了闸门。

sentences.en: And let me guess, Shein was one of the companies that took that opportunity and ran with it.
sentences.zh: 让我猜猜，Shein就是抓住这个机会并迅速壮大的公司之一。

sentences.en: Yeah, Shein was one of those companies.
sentences.zh: 没错，Shein就是其中之一。

sentences.en: And also, Timu and Amazon and Walmart all took advantage of this loophole to send a lot of small, cheap packages to the United States from China.
sentences.zh: 还有Temu、亚马逊和沃尔玛，它们都利用了这个漏洞，从中国向美国发送了大量廉价的小包裹。

sentences.en: But it's Shein that really created an entire business model around it.
sentences.zh: 但Shein是真正围绕这个漏洞建立起整个商业模式的公司。

sentences.en: So, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 那我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: What does this entirely new business model look like?
sentences.zh: 这个全新的商业模式到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: So, when Shein first started drawing a lot of attention, people compared it to H&M and Zara, early models of fast fashion.
sentences.zh: Shein刚开始引起关注时，人们把它比作H&M和Zara，也就是早期的快时尚模式。

sentences.en: But H&M and Zara,
sentences.zh: 但H&M和Zara，

sentences.en: the way their business model worked is they would look at runway trends and order a bunch of clothes in advance and then ship it to warehouses in the United States in bulk.
sentences.zh: 它们的商业模式是观察秀场趋势，提前预订一批服装，然后大批量运往美国的仓库。

sentences.en: And Shein is totally different than that.
sentences.zh: 而Shein则完全不同。

sentences.en: It's not actually one single brand.
sentences.zh: 它实际上并不是一个单一的品牌。

sentences.en: It's an online marketplace that sources from a network of thousands of Chinese factories.
sentences.zh: 它是一个在线市场，货源来自中国成千上万家工厂组成的网络。

sentences.en: And instead of having specific collections for the time of year, they're just constantly creating thousands of different garments every day.
sentences.zh: 他们不是按季节推出特定系列，而是每天都在不断创造数千种不同的服装。

sentences.en: And Shein responds essentially in real time to trends.
sentences.zh: Shein基本上是实时响应潮流的。

sentences.en: They have this proprietary system that allows them to place really small orders with really short turnaround times with their suppliers.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有一套专有系统，允许他们向供应商下达极小批量的订单，且周转时间极短。

sentences.en: That enables Shein to avoid the cost of maintaining a lot of inventory.
sentences.zh: 这使得Shein能够避免维持大量库存的成本。

sentences.en: And unlike Zara or H&M, who ship their clothes in bulk to warehouses in the United States, who then distribute it to shops, Shein mails their items directly to customers.
sentences.zh: 与Zara或H&M不同，后者将服装大批量运往美国仓库，再分发到门店，而Shein则是直接将商品邮寄给客户。

sentences.en: And what's interesting is that because of their proprietary system, they can see how things are selling on the app and quickly notify suppliers that they need to make more.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，由于他们的专有系统，他们可以看到应用上的销售情况，并迅速通知供应商需要生产更多。

sentences.en: So sometimes when you buy something on Shein, it might not actually even have been made yet.
sentences.zh: 所以有时候当你在Shein上买东西时，它可能甚至还没被生产出来。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so if all of a sudden everyone in your TikTok feed is wearing baggy cargo pants or lime green crop tops, immediately you can also see those being offered on Shein.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你的TikTok信息流里突然大家都穿上了宽松工装裤或荧光绿短上衣，你立刻就能在Shein上看到同款。

sentences.en: And if more people start buying them, the platform can quickly ask more suppliers to keep making them.
sentences.zh: 如果买的人越来越多，平台可以迅速要求更多供应商继续生产。

sentences.en: That enables them to offer a huge variety of products on their app for very little money.
sentences.zh: 这使得他们能够在应用上以极低的价格提供种类繁多的产品。

sentences.en: So instead of fast fashion, it's more like ultra fast fashion.
sentences.zh: 所以与其说是快时尚，不如说是“超快时尚”。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is kind of crazy.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实有点疯狂。

sentences.en: You see something on TikTok and before you know it, it's delivered directly to your doorstep and for like no money.
sentences.zh: 你在TikTok上看到什么，没过多久它就直接送到你家门口了，而且几乎没花什么钱。

sentences.en: It's a little bit like consumerism on steroids or something.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是打了兴奋剂的消费主义。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: And Shein is not without its critics.
sentences.zh: 而且Shein也并非没有批评者。

sentences.en: There are all kinds of concerns about Shein and ultra fast fashion.
sentences.zh: 关于Shein和超快时尚，存在着各种各样的担忧。

sentences.en: There are concerns about labor practices at some of the factories that supply for Shein.
sentences.zh: 人们担心Shein供应商工厂的劳工待遇问题。

sentences.en: And of course, there are environmental concerns because millions of packages are being flown across the world every day.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有环境问题，因为每天有数百万个包裹被空运到世界各地。

sentences.en: And because the prices are so low, it makes the clothes feel almost disposable.
sentences.zh: 而且因为价格太低，衣服感觉就像是一次性的。

sentences.en: And in the United States, a lot of businesses were angry that Shein and other companies were using this loophole.
sentences.zh: 在美国，许多企业对Shein和其他公司利用这个漏洞感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And not paying any taxes.
sentences.zh: 而且不用缴纳任何税款。

sentences.en: They felt that was really undercutting their prices.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这严重压低了他们的价格。

sentences.en: Like, for example, Forever 21 partly blamed Shein and Timu and their use of the de minimis exemption when it filed for bankruptcy earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 例如，Forever 21在今年早些时候申请破产时，部分归咎于Shein和Temu对最低限度条款的利用。

sentences.en: And all of that concern eventually reached the White House.
sentences.zh: 所有这些担忧最终传到了白宫。

sentences.en: It plays right into President Trump's narrative about China ripping off the United States.
sentences.zh: 这完全符合特朗普总统关于“中国正在敲诈美国”的叙事。

sentences.en: It absolutely plays into President Trump's narrative that, particularly when it comes to trade, the playing field with China has not been even.
sentences.zh: 这绝对符合特朗普总统的叙事，即在贸易方面，与中国的竞争环境一直是不公平的。

sentences.en: And Trump also says the de minimis exemption was leading to fentanyl and the chemicals that are involved in making it coming into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 特朗普还表示，最低限度条款导致芬太尼及其制造原料从中国流入美国，

sentences.en: from China because he said drug traffickers were taking advantage of the limited checks on these packages to sneak illegal substances into the country.
sentences.zh: 因为他说毒贩利用了这些包裹检查有限的漏洞，将非法物质偷运进国内。

sentences.en: Which is bad news for all the Americans who have become used to paying next to nothing for these clothes, right?
sentences.zh: 这对所有已经习惯了以几乎零成本买衣服的美国人来说是个坏消息，对吧？

sentences.en: But it sounds like it could be existential for companies like Shein and all the people who make the clothes.
sentences.zh: 但这听起来对Shein这样的公司以及所有制造这些衣服的人来说，可能是生存危机。

sentences.en: Which is why I went to Guangzhou, a city in the Southeast that is in many ways the heart of the global garment industry.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我去了广州，这座位于东南部的城市在很多方面都是全球服装业的心脏。

sentences.en: It's where many of Shein's hauls are made.
sentences.zh: Shein的许多产品都是在那里制造的。

sentences.en: And I wanted to go there to see what the end of this loophole means for the millions of people who work in this industry.
sentences.zh: 我想去那里看看，这个漏洞的终结对在这个行业工作的数百万人意味着什么。

sentences.en: And ultimately what it means for the fate of fast fashion.
sentences.zh: 以及最终对快时尚的命运意味着什么。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”拼图。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责创作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人们制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So Megan, you're actually talking to us from China.
sentences.zh: 那么梅根，你现在实际上是在中国和我们通话。

sentences.en: You're in China.
sentences.zh: 你在中国。

sentences.en: Tell us about your recent trip to Guangzhou.
sentences.zh: 跟我们讲讲你最近的广州之行吧。

sentences.en: What did you see?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: So the thing you need to know is that China makes nearly one in every three garments sold around the world.
sentences.zh: 你需要知道的是，全球销售的服装中，近三分之一产自中国。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And much of that comes from Guangzhou in the factories that are part of the Xi'an network.
sentences.zh: 而其中很大一部分来自广州，来自Shein网络中的工厂。

sentences.en: And in a lot of ways, this city is really the global hub of garment manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，这座城市确实是全球服装制造业的中心。

sentences.en: And I wanted to see what the impact of the end of the De Minimis loophole was going to be on the ground here.
sentences.zh: 我想亲眼看看“最低限度条款”漏洞的终结在这里会产生什么影响。

sentences.en: So my colleague Xi Zhao and I went to Guangzhou to check it out.
sentences.zh: 所以我的同事赵曦和我去了广州一探究竟。

sentences.en: Many of the garment factories in Guangzhou are essentially open-air workshops.
sentences.zh: 广州的许多服装厂本质上都是露天作坊。

sentences.en: They're like big warehouses with garage doors that open onto the street.
sentences.zh: 它们就像巨大的仓库，车库门直接开向街道。

sentences.en: And they're full of sewing machines that are clacking away at all hours of the day and night.
sentences.zh: 里面摆满了缝纫机，日夜不停地发出咔哒咔哒的响声。

sentences.en: And different workshops have different functions.
sentences.zh: 不同的作坊有不同的分工。

sentences.en: So some places might assemble whole garments, and other places will just sew on zippers and ruffles.
sentences.zh: 有些地方负责组装整件衣服，而有些地方只负责缝拉链和荷叶边。

sentences.en: And one of the places that we went was a labor market for day laborers.
sentences.zh: 我们去过的地方之一是一个临时工劳务市场。

sentences.en: This kind of informal market where a lot of the workshops go to recruit their labor for the day.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非正式的市场，许多作坊都会到这里招募当天的劳动力。

sentences.en: And hundreds of managers from different factories were lined up on the sidewalk looking for people to do different sewing tasks all day long.
sentences.zh: 数百名来自不同工厂的经理排在人行道上，整天都在寻找工人来完成各种缝纫任务。

sentences.en: So some places are putting together the main seams of a garment, and then down the street is a place that will sew in the zippers,
sentences.zh: 有些地方负责缝合衣服的主接缝，而沿着街道走下去，另一家店则负责缝拉链，

sentences.en: and another one that will do the elastic waistband.
sentences.zh: 还有一家专门做松紧腰带。

sentences.en: And then there's a different company that will come and pick up the packages and bring them to a collection point.
sentences.zh: 然后会有另一家公司过来把这些包裹收走，送到集散点。

sentences.en: So all over the city, you can see trucks that are piled high with rolls of fabric just rocketing down the street.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以在城市各处看到，装满布料卷的卡车在街上飞驰而过。

sentences.en: And at the same time, they're being passed by guys with carts and driving vans who are collecting the finished products and taking them to the airport.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，推着小车和开着货车的人们正从他们身边经过，收集成品并运往机场。

sentences.en: So there's this whole ecosystem of businesses that are all interconnected in the task of making clothes as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里形成了一个完整的商业生态系统，所有环节都环环相扣，旨在以最快速度生产服装。

sentences.en: So it sounds like it's actually a very sophisticated operation, almost like a sort of supercharged Ford assembly line.
sentences.zh: 听起来这确实是一个非常复杂的运作体系，几乎就像一种超级加速版的福特流水线。

sentences.en: If you can imagine that assembly line, like spread over an entire city, that is essentially what it is like.
sentences.zh: 如果你能想象那种流水线分布在整个城市里，那基本上就是它的样子。

sentences.en: So you've got just whole neighborhoods that are geared toward the production of clothes.
sentences.zh: 整个街区都是围绕着服装生产来运转的。

sentences.en: And this industry is a really important part of the economy there.
sentences.zh: 这个行业是当地经济中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: It employs millions of people, and a lot of them are migrant workers who come to the city from all over China.
sentences.zh: 它雇佣了数百万人，其中许多是从中国各地来到城市的农民工。

sentences.en: So we talked to managers and workers, and what they told us is that business was already down.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了经理和工人，他们告诉我们生意已经下滑了。

sentences.en: In the month of April, Xi'an was putting in fewer orders in anticipation of the loophole being closed.
sentences.zh: 四月份，希音（Shein）减少了订单，以应对漏洞即将被堵上的预期。

sentences.en: And because of that, factories were hiring fewer workers.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，工厂雇佣的工人也变少了。

sentences.en: Some people said they were considering moving their factories to other provinces where they thought they could pay workers less, or even out of the country to places like Vietnam.
sentences.zh: 有些人说他们正在考虑把工厂搬到劳动力成本更低的省份，甚至搬到越南等国外地区。

sentences.en: And many of the people we spoke to had actually seen nearby businesses close down.
sentences.zh: 我们采访的许多人都亲眼目睹了附近的企业倒闭。

sentences.en: Now, we were in Guangzhou on the day the loophole closed.
sentences.zh: 我们到达广州的那天，正是那个漏洞被堵上的日子。

sentences.en: And one of the people that we talked to was Han Junshou.
sentences.zh: 我们采访的对象之一是韩俊寿（音译）。

sentences.en: Junshou is 30, and she is the second-generation factory owner.
sentences.zh: 俊寿今年30岁，是第二代工厂主。

sentences.en: She makes house slippers and bags and other accessories, and she sells them on Xi'an and Timu.
sentences.zh: 她生产家居拖鞋、包袋和其他配饰，并在希音和Temu上销售。

sentences.en: And one of her most popular products is a pair of fluffy socks.
sentences.zh: 她最受欢迎的产品之一是毛绒袜。

sentences.en: She markets as being for pajama parties and girls' nights.
sentences.zh: 她将其营销为睡衣派对和闺蜜之夜的必备品。

sentences.en: And she was telling us how she gets inspiration for her colorways by looking at the colors of outfits that Kendall Jenner posts on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，她的配色灵感来自于肯达尔·詹娜（Kendall Jenner）在Instagram上发布的穿搭颜色。

sentences.en: I mean, she clearly understands the American teen market.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她显然非常了解美国青少年市场。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But Junshou says that her orders in April were down nearly 20% compared to previous months.
sentences.zh: 但俊寿说，她四月份的订单比前几个月下降了近20%。

sentences.en: And she's already starting to look for other markets to make up for the loss of American consumers.
sentences.zh: 她已经开始寻找其他市场来弥补美国消费者流失带来的损失。

sentences.en: How's she going to do that?
sentences.zh: 她打算怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, if Americans aren't going to buy things because they're more expensive,
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果美国人因为价格上涨而不愿购买，

sentences.en: Junshou is going to have to sell her fluffy socks and bags in other places.
sentences.zh: 俊寿就必须把她的毛绒袜和包袋卖到其他地方去。

sentences.en: So she's looking to Europe and South America.
sentences.zh: 所以她正在关注欧洲和南美市场。

sentences.en: And that's something we heard from other business owners, too.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们从其他企业主那里听到的情况。

sentences.en: There are all these chat forums online that are almost offering, like, crowdsourced tech support,
sentences.zh: 网上有各种各样的聊天论坛，几乎就像是在提供众包技术支持，

sentences.en: teaching people how to set up an account in Bahasa Indonesia to target Indonesian customers, or what buttons to click to get set up to sell on MercadoLibre in South America.
sentences.zh: 教人们如何注册印尼语账户以瞄准印尼客户，或者点击哪些按钮来设置在南美的MercadoLibre上销售。

sentences.en: But I imagine it can't be that easy to replace the American market because American consumers just seem to buy so much more stuff than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 但我认为要取代美国市场恐怕没那么容易，因为美国消费者的购买力似乎远超其他人。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: is China's biggest single market.
sentences.zh: 是中国最大的单一市场。

sentences.en: It's a big economy with a lot of consumers who have enough disposable income that they can buy reusable water bottles
sentences.zh: 这是一个庞大的经济体，拥有大量可支配收入的消费者，他们可以购买可重复使用的水瓶、

sentences.en: and strollers and toasters and flash drives and basically anything they need or want from China.
sentences.zh: 婴儿车、烤面包机、闪存盘，以及基本上任何他们需要或想要的中国商品。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So on top of looking abroad for other markets, factory owners like Junshou are also trying to target shoppers in China.
sentences.zh: 因此，除了向海外寻找其他市场外，像俊寿这样的工厂主也在努力瞄准中国国内的购物者。

sentences.en: And the Chinese government really needs this to happen because the economy has been pretty slow in the last couple of years and exports have really been the main driver of growth.
sentences.zh: 中国政府确实需要这种情况发生，因为过去几年经济增长放缓，而出口一直是增长的主要驱动力。

sentences.en: But the problem is people in China have been really careful about spending money.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，中国民众在花钱方面一直非常谨慎。

sentences.en: And Junshou ultimately sees this as a lose-lose situation.
sentences.zh: 俊寿最终认为这是一个双输的局面。

sentences.en: She thinks that not only are Chinese manufacturers going to suffer, but American shoppers are going to also.
sentences.zh: 她认为不仅中国制造商会受损，美国购物者也会受到影响。

sentences.en: She said that China makes so much stuff.
sentences.zh: 她说中国制造了太多的东西。

sentences.en: If you cut out China, where are you going to be able to buy all your products?
sentences.zh: 如果你把中国排除在外，你还能去哪里买到所有的产品呢？

sentences.en: And she definitely thinks people in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 她坚信美国人

sentences.en: won't be able to replicate manufacturing the way that Guangzhou has.
sentences.zh: 无法复制广州那样的制造能力。

sentences.en: That there was no way that Guangzhou wasn't going to be the engine of the global garment industry.
sentences.zh: 广州注定会成为全球服装业的引擎。

sentences.en: And if she's right that America can replicate the system and bring that kind of manufacturing to the U.S., that basically means the end of this ultra-cheap clothing for Americans?
sentences.zh: 如果她是对的，即美国无法复制这套系统并将这种制造业带回国内，那是否意味着美国人将告别这种超廉价服装？

sentences.en: Well, President Trump could change his mind.
sentences.zh: 嗯，特朗普总统可能会改变主意。

sentences.en: He could pause or reverse his position on closing the loophole altogether.
sentences.zh: 他可能会暂停或完全撤回关于堵上漏洞的立场。

sentences.en: Yeah, that has happened before.
sentences.zh: 是的，这种情况以前发生过。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's rolled back the tariffs from an additional 145 percent down to 30 percent.
sentences.zh: 他曾将关税从额外145%下调至30%。

sentences.en: But that's for most goods coming from China.
sentences.zh: 但这适用于大多数从中国进口的商品。

sentences.en: For the packages that we're talking about, which previously entered the United States without paying any taxes,
sentences.zh: 对于我们讨论的那些之前无需缴纳任何税款即可进入美国的包裹，

sentences.en: now they'll be subject to either a tariff of 54 percent or a flat fee of $100.
sentences.zh: 现在它们将面临54%的关税或100美元的固定费用。

sentences.en: And more than likely, it's the shopper who will end up paying that extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 而且很有可能，最终承担这笔额外成本的是消费者。

sentences.en: So that means anything you buy from Xi'an that's coming from China will cost more and could mean that people will buy fewer things.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你从希音购买的任何中国商品都会涨价，这可能导致人们减少购买量。

sentences.en: And a Xi'an haul might become a little bit more of a mini haul.
sentences.zh: “希音大采购”可能会变成“迷你采购”。

sentences.en: And some people might not be so unhappy about that, right?
sentences.zh: 有些人可能对此并不感到难过，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it sort of raises these bigger questions about our consumer culture.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这引发了关于我们消费文化的更大疑问。

sentences.en: We've gotten so addicted to all this cheap stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们已经对这些廉价商品产生了严重的依赖。

sentences.en: And there is this question, kind of elephant in the room, you know, would we be better off if there was less stuff?
sentences.zh: 这里有一个显而易见的问题，你知道，如果东西少一点，我们会不会过得更好？

sentences.en: And I guess I'm wondering, who's this going to hurt more long term, China or the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，从长远来看，这对中国还是美国伤害更大？

sentences.en: I mean, that's a big question at the heart of the trade war right now.
sentences.zh: 这是一个目前贸易战核心的大问题。

sentences.en: It's really difficult to say.
sentences.zh: 真的很难说。

sentences.en: Like I said, China is an export-driven economy.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，中国是一个出口导向型经济体。

sentences.en: And this trade war is really bad news for the one area that had been driving growth.
sentences.zh: 这场贸易战对一直驱动增长的领域来说确实是个坏消息。

sentences.en: But it's also not just a place of manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 但中国不仅仅是一个制造业基地。

sentences.en: It's also a place of innovation.
sentences.zh: 它也是一个创新中心。

sentences.en: China is quickly becoming a leader in other technologies.
sentences.zh: 中国正迅速成为其他技术领域的领导者。

sentences.en: In many ways, pushback from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，美国的阻挠

sentences.en: just pushes China to become more self-sufficient in many areas.
sentences.zh: 只会促使中国在许多领域变得更加自给自足。

sentences.en: And we can see that happening in semiconductors and artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到这种情况在半导体和人工智能领域发生了。

sentences.en: And so it might just be that the garment industry is one of the next places where that happens.
sentences.zh: 所以服装业可能只是下一个发生这种情况的领域。

sentences.en: And in the end, this could accelerate the shift that the Chinese government hopes it would to helping China become a more consumption-driven economy.
sentences.zh: 最终，这可能会加速中国政府所希望的转变，即帮助中国成为一个更依赖消费驱动的经济体。

sentences.en: And how about the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 那美国呢？

sentences.en: There are several things to consider.
sentences.zh: 有几点需要考虑。

sentences.en: This is definitely going to hurt the United States in pure economic terMs.
sentences.zh: 从纯经济角度来看，这肯定会损害美国利益。

sentences.en: Very few economists believe that it will actually create a significant amount of the kind of middle-class manufacturing jobs that President Trump has been promising.
sentences.zh: 很少有经济学家相信这真的能创造出特朗普总统所承诺的那种大量中产阶级制造业岗位。

sentences.en: And like I said, things will definitely get more expensive.
sentences.zh: 而且正如我所说，商品价格肯定会上涨。

sentences.en: And that means Americans will likely buy fewer things.
sentences.zh: 这意味着美国人可能会减少购买。

sentences.en: And the president himself does not actually dispute this.
sentences.zh: 总统本人实际上并不否认这一点。

sentences.en: In fact, he seems to be actively embracing it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他似乎正在积极拥抱这一观点。

sentences.en: Remember when Trump recently said that thing about American kids don't need to have 30 dolls?
sentences.zh: 还记得特朗普最近说美国孩子不需要拥有30个洋娃娃吗？

sentences.en: Maybe they can just have two or three?
sentences.zh: 也许他们只需要两三个？

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: Yeah, that's the story he's telling.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是他所传达的信息。

sentences.en: And it's a position that extends to some of his administration, too.
sentences.zh: 这一立场也延伸到了他政府中的一些人身上。

sentences.en: Scott Besson, the Treasury Secretary, said something really similar, that the American dream is not about having access to cheap stuff.
sentences.zh: 财政部长斯科特·贝森（Scott Besson）也表达了类似的观点，即美国梦并不在于能够买到廉价商品。

sentences.en: It's about prosperity and upward mobility and economic security.
sentences.zh: 它关乎繁荣、向上流动和经济安全。

sentences.en: And that for too long, the people making the trade deals have lost sight of this.
sentences.zh: 而且长期以来，制定贸易协议的人们已经忽视了这一点。

sentences.en: So he's kind of reframing this all as a good thing, that we'll be breaking a bad addiction to cheap stuff we don't need.
sentences.zh: 所以他把这一切重新定义为一件好事，即我们将戒掉对不需要的廉价商品的恶习。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what's interesting here is that even people who are skeptical of Trump's tariffs might be in favor of reigning in fast fashion for environmental reasons or because they're against overconsumption.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，即使是那些对特朗普关税持怀疑态度的人，也可能出于环保原因或反对过度消费而支持限制快时尚。

sentences.en: And you can actually see that playing out online.
sentences.zh: 你实际上可以在网上看到这种趋势。

sentences.en: We need to stop filling up our closets and fill up our banks.
sentences.zh: 我们需要停止填满衣橱，转而填满银行账户。

sentences.en: There's this whole buy less movement.
sentences.zh: 现在出现了一场“少买”运动。

sentences.en: We're not rich enough to afford these tariffs, so let's embrace the idea of underconsumption.
sentences.zh: 我们没钱负担这些关税，所以让我们拥抱“低消费”的理念吧。

sentences.en: Maybe we need to start taking responsibility for how much textile waste is in landfills in other countries.
sentences.zh: 也许我们需要开始为其他国家垃圾填埋场中堆积的纺织废料承担责任了。

sentences.en: Our relationship with consumption is fundamentally unhealthy and people cannot stop buying stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们与消费的关系从根本上是不健康的，人们无法停止购物。

sentences.en: On TikTok, alongside the massive Sheehan hauls, you can also see people having conversations about consuming less.
sentences.zh: 在TikTok上，除了海量的希音购物分享，你也能看到人们在讨论如何减少消费。

sentences.en: If you are the type to buy a new outfit for every date night, every girl's night out, every vacation, stop.
sentences.zh: 如果你是那种每次约会、每次闺蜜聚会、每次度假都要买新衣服的人，停下来吧。

sentences.en: Your last outfits slayed.
sentences.zh: 你上次穿的衣服就很棒。

sentences.en: Wear those again.
sentences.zh: 再穿一次吧。

sentences.en: And being more intentional about where they're buying things from.
sentences.zh: 并且在购买商品时更加深思熟虑。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: If there was ever a time to develop an interest in second-year fashion, I swear now is the time.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么时候该培养对二手时尚的兴趣，我发誓现在就是时候。

sentences.en: So the end of the de minimis loophole might result in something that a lot of people agree with.
sentences.zh: 所以，取消“最低限度”豁免条款可能会带来一个许多人都认同的结果。

sentences.en: Making fast fashion a little harder to buy.
sentences.zh: 让快时尚变得更难买到。

sentences.en: I hope that all of this will just reset our relationship with consumption and material goods.
sentences.zh: 我希望这一切能重塑我们与消费和物质商品的关系。

sentences.en: It could be wishful thinking, but that is one potential benefit of all this.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一厢情愿，但这确实是这一切的一个潜在好处。

sentences.en: I think I need to introduce my daughter to some of those other TikTok channels.
sentences.zh: 我想我得给我女儿介绍一下那些其他的TikTok频道了。

sentences.en: Good luck.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运。

sentences.en: Thank you, Megan.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，梅根。

sentences.en: Thank you, Katrin.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，卡特琳。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, President Trump met the new leader of Syria, Ahmed al-Sharah, a man who once ran a branch of al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普总统会见了叙利亚新领导人艾哈迈德·沙拉（Ahmed al-Sharah），此人曾经营过基地组织的一个分支。

sentences.en: Last year, he led the rebel alliance that ousted Syria's longstanding dictator, Bashar al-Assad.
sentences.zh: 去年，他领导了推翻叙利亚长期独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德（Bashar al-Assad）的叛军联盟。

sentences.en: It was the first time in 25 years that leaders from the two countries had met, and came one day after Trump announced a plan to lift all sanctions on Syria.
sentences.zh: 这是两国领导人25年来首次会晤，就在特朗普宣布计划取消对叙利亚所有制裁的一天后举行。

sentences.en: When asked what he made of a Syrian counterpart, Trump called him attractive and tough.
sentences.zh: 当被问及对这位叙利亚同僚的看法时，特朗普称他很有魅力且强硬。

sentences.en: Trump also said al-Sharah had a good shot at turning his country around.
sentences.zh: 特朗普还表示，沙拉很有希望扭转他国家的局面。

sentences.en: The encounter marked a stunning reversal for the Syrian leader.
sentences.zh: 这次会面标志着这位叙利亚领导人的惊人转变。

sentences.en: Until just five months ago, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就在五个月前，美国

sentences.en: had offered up to $10 million for information leading to his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 还曾悬赏高达1000万美元征集导致他被捕的信息。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Ricky Nowetsky, Shannon Lynn, and Anna Foley, with help from Claire Tennisketter.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由瑞奇·诺韦茨基（Ricky Nowetsky）、香农·琳恩（Shannon Lynn）和安娜·福利（Anna Foley）制作，克莱尔·坦尼斯凯特（Claire Tennisketter）提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Maria Byrne and Paige Cowett.
sentences.zh: 由玛丽亚·伯恩（Maria Byrne）和佩奇·考维特（Paige Cowett）编辑。

sentences.en: Research help by Susan Lee.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·李（Susan Lee）提供了研究协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Marion Lozano, Diane Wong, Rowan Nemisto, and Pat McCusker, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 包含玛丽昂·洛萨诺（Marion Lozano）、黛安·王（Diane Wong）、罗文·内米斯托（Rowan Nemisto）和帕特·麦卡斯克（Pat McCusker）的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德（Chris Wood）进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格（Jim Brunberg）和本·兰兹伯格（Ben Landsberg）创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to C.E.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢C.E.

sentences.en: Zhao.
sentences.zh: 赵（Zhao）。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Katrin Benholt.
sentences.zh: 我是卡特琳·本霍尔特（Katrin Benholt）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一批自诩为改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我是莎拉·凯尼格，为您讲述那些试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的人们的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何平台收听。

sentences.en: Let's see.
sentences.zh: 让我看看。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
